lines.zh: 我沿着林缘走，步子很大。
lines.en: I walk the forest edge with long strides.

lines.zh: 我的头冠在阳光下有点亮。
lines.en: My crest catches the sun.
I walk on four legs, steady.
I duck under the low branches.
My tail swings behind me.
I step around a fern.
I break a dead branch underfoot.

lines.zh: 我走一会儿就停下来吃。
lines.en: I stop to eat as I go.
Then I raise my head.

lines.zh: 我的头冠像个空心的斧。
lines.en: My crest is a hollow axe.

lines.zh: 我的步子比同伴慢一点。
lines.en: My pace is a little behind the others.
I stand with leaves in my mouth.
I am chewing.

lines.zh: 我的头冠在阳光下泛红。
lines.en: My crest glows red in the sun.
Sun filters through the leaves.
My crest bobs.
I am not worried about anything.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴扫开脚边的落叶。
lines.en: I sweep the fallen leaves aside with my tail.
My legs are thick.
I chew bark, grinding my teeth slowly.

lines.zh: 我把耳朵转过去，又转回来。
lines.en: I turn an ear toward it, then back.
I lower my head to graze again.
There is plenty to eat in these woods.
I stand, quite at ease.

lines.zh: 我的鸭嘴状吻部还在嚼。
lines.en: My duck-bill muzzle is still chewing.
You are not as tall as I am.
I am not very afraid.
We have not seen you in the herd.
The lambeosaur's crest tilts aside.
My crest faces the sun.
Would you like some leaves?
One slow blink, then I look at you.
My call is deep.
Just stand a little farther off.
With a muffled call, I retreat behind a tree.

lines.zh: 森林里我们成群，头冠很响。
lines.en: In the forest herd, my crest is loud.
A scratch across my crest.
A shallow cut shows on my hide.
All four feet plant firm again.
I have not run.
I pull my neck back into my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我甩甩头，头冠晃了两下。
lines.en: I shake my head; my crest wobbles.
I sniff.

lines.zh: 我低头咬下一整根枝条。
lines.en: I lower my head and tear off a whole branch.
I stretch my neck over.
I take a bite.

lines.zh: 我嚼着树叶，嘴边都是汁。
lines.en: I chew leaves, juice on my lips.
This fern frond is tender and sweet.

lines.zh: 森林这么大，我慢慢地靠近。
lines.en: The forest is wide. I approach slowly.

lines.zh: 树叶的味道，比逃跑重要。
lines.en: The smell of leaves matters more than running.
I don't budge; I keep chewing.
I barely move.
I am bigger than you.
I raise a foreleg and the ground trembles.

lines.zh: 你被我的膝盖弹得坐倒。
lines.en: My knee bounces you onto your back.
Sorry.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀撞到我的冠了。
lines.en: Your shoulder hit my crest.
Make way — my tail still has to pass.
The young walk in the middle.
I bring up the rear.
There is plenty to eat.
We eat as we walk.
Someone calls out.
We all raise our heads.
Nothing; we move on.
It will be dark soon; we look for a place.

lines.zh: 低头的功夫，就把它叼起来了。
lines.en: A dip of my head lifts it up.
This is a branch.
I chew it.
I spit it out.
I nudge it into the bushes with my mouth.
I sniff; it is not grass.
That is yours.
Put me down. I can walk on my own.

lines.zh: 我的头冠里传出一声低鸣。
lines.en: A low call sounds from my crest.
I gather the young against my legs.
I move toward my herd.

lines.zh: 兽群围成一圈，把我护在中间。
lines.en: The herd rings around me.

lines.zh: 我的鼻孔一张一合地喷气。
lines.en: My nostrils flare and puff.
My tail comes up.
I rear up on my hind legs.
Crest down. Pushing in.
The herd hears it.
I stand in front of the young.
I do not want to fight.
But I will not run.
My crest blows a low note.

lines.zh: 我停一下，听林子的回声。
lines.en: I pause to hear the forest echo.
My herd is watching too.
I paw the ground.
My tail lashes loudly.

lines.zh: 头冠里的声音传得很远。
lines.en: The call from my crest carries far.

lines.zh: 我低着头，一步一步压近。
lines.en: Head low, I close in step by step.

lines.zh: 我头顶的冠，能把叫声传过林子。
lines.en: My crest carries my call across the woods.
The tree will not hold.
This charge will be heavy.
You step back again.

lines.zh: 我一步一步，踩得落叶响。
lines.en: Step by step, my feet crackle the leaves.

lines.zh: 我蹄下的腐叶被踩得粉碎。
lines.en: The leaf litter crumbles under my hooves.
I lower my head, crest toward you.
Two — the next step is the charge.
My crest hit your chest.
My forelegs come down.
I kick you.
My forehoof comes down beside your foot.

lines.zh: 我的头冠是中空的，能吹响。
lines.en: My crest is hollow and can sound.

lines.zh: 我低头一顶，把你推出去。
lines.en: I lower my head and shove you away.
I strike your shoulder with my crest first.

lines.zh: 我前蹄落地，震得你踉跄。
lines.en: My forehooves land and stagger you.
I do not want to do that again.
But if you will not leave.
I will charge again.
My neck is thick.
This is the last.
I step out of the trees.

lines.zh: 我的头冠第一次晒到太阳。
lines.en: My crest catches the sun for the first time.
There is grass here, and water.
I lower my head and take a mouthful.
Three to five of us together.
I walk slowly into the clearing.
My call is deep.
We spread out to graze.
There is enough here to fill us.

lines.zh: 林间小路上，我踩出新蹄印。
lines.en: On the forest path, my hooves leave fresh prints.
We start moving inward.
The day is bright.
These are good woods.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的腿，我踏着往后退。
lines.en: Fire catches my leg and I stamp backward.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下来，压断了几株蕨。
lines.en: I roll down the slope, crushing ferns.

lines.zh: 水没过我的背，我伸长脖子。
lines.en: Water covers my back and I stretch my neck up.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我震倒，树也断了。
lines.en: The blast knocks me down and breaks trees.
The arrow hit my frill edge, not deep.

lines.zh: 咒光打过来，我往旁边躲。
lines.en: Spell-light strikes and I dodge aside.

lines.zh: 这一片都被我们吃完了。
lines.en: We have eaten this patch bare.
Lightning hits the tree beside me.
